notes: The first «عبد الله» is «أخبرنا عبد الله» (the transmitter after Muhammad b. Muqatil); the last is the Companion «عن عبد الله رضى الله عنه», so the same words are written twice and numbered.
«ونافع» is written with the attached «و» removed from the surface.
The Prophet is the end of the chain and is not written.
